# Tendlyn

> Tendlyn designs and manufactures custom DTC packaging for brands shipping worldwide.

## About

Tendlyn is the trading brand of **Guangzhou Tendlyn Trading Co., Ltd.**, founded in **2009** and headquartered in Panyu District, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

Tendlyn is a packaging design and OEM manufacturing partner for DTC brands, designers, and packaging companies. Core work covers custom packaging boxes, tissue paper, logo stickers, sealing stickers, packaging bags, hang tags, and insert cards—often as a coordinated unboxing set.

Primary markets: US, UK, EU, Australia, and other export destinations. Typical categories: perfume, candles, cosmetics, coffee, cakes, and lifestyle products.

Company page: https://www.tendlyn.com/about/

## Quality & compliance notes

Partner production facilities follow ISO 9001-style quality systems. FSC Chain of Custody paper options are available on request. Material compliance support covers REACH-aware selection and food-contact / cosmetics-adjacent packaging documentation during sampling. Color control uses digital proofs, golden samples, and production checks.

## Products

- [Packaging Boxes](https://www.tendlyn.com/products/boxes/): Rigid and folding cartons for perfume, candles, cosmetics, and gifts.
- [Tissue Paper](https://www.tendlyn.com/products/tissue-paper/): Soft branded tissue for protection and first reveal.
- [Logo Stickers](https://www.tendlyn.com/products/logo-stickers/): Die-cut logo labels with foil, emboss, and color matching.
- [Sealing Stickers](https://www.tendlyn.com/products/sealing-stickers/): Closure seals for bags, boxes, and tissue wraps.
- [Packaging Bags](https://www.tendlyn.com/products/packaging-bags/): Mailers, paper shopping bags, and custom DTC bags.
- [Hang Tags](https://www.tendlyn.com/products/hang-tags/): Apparel and product tags with stringing and tactile finishes.
- [Insert Cards](https://www.tendlyn.com/products/insert-cards/): Care cards, thank-you notes, and instruction inserts.

## How it works

1. Brief — artwork, sizes, materials, finishes, quantities; clarify structure options and shipping constraints
2. Design — dielines, material boards, artwork placement that survives manufacturing
3. Proof & sample — digital proof and physical golden-sample sign-off (see Sampling system below)
4. Produce — print, finish, convert, QC against agreed tolerances; first-article photo updates available
5. Ship — export packing, carton labeling for your fulfillment flow, delivery to nominated destinations

Details: https://www.tendlyn.com/how-it-works/

## Sampling system

Tendlyn does not jump straight to bulk. Sampling is a locked gate before mass production:

1. **Digital proof** — review structure panels, artwork placement, and color intent on screen / PDF.
2. **Physical sample (golden sample)** — evaluate board/stock, die-cut, finish (foil, soft-touch, etc.), and assembly feel.
3. **Written sign-off** — client approves the golden sample; that file becomes the production reference.
4. **Production QC** — color matching, AQL-style checks, and pre-shipment inspection against the signed sample.
5. **Export packing** — moisture protection, carton marking, and warehouse-ready palletizing when required.

What sampling locks: structure, color, finishes, and unboxing sequence consistency across the set (box + tissue + stickers + inserts, etc.).

Sample runs are available for approval. Production MOQs depend on structure and finish—share quantities and destinations on the quote form for a recommended path.

Related trust notes: https://www.tendlyn.com/about/#trust

## FAQ summary

**What packaging does Tendlyn manufacture?**  
Custom DTC packaging—boxes, tissue paper, logo stickers, sealing stickers, packaging bags, hang tags, and insert cards—often as a coordinated set so materials and finishes stay consistent.

**Who do you work with?**  
DTC brands, designers, and packaging companies shipping worldwide. Frequent categories: perfume, candles, cosmetics, coffee, cakes, and lifestyle.

**Do you offer samples and proofs before bulk?**  
Yes. After the brief: design → digital proofs → physical samples, so structure, color, and finishes are locked before production.

**What is a typical minimum order?**  
Sample runs are available for approval. Production MOQs vary by structure and finish; send quantities and destinations via Get a Quote for a clear recommendation.

**Can you ship internationally?**  
Yes. Export packing and shipping to nominated markets, with carton labeling suited to fulfillment or wholesale flows. Primary markets include US, UK, EU, and Australia.

**How do I start a project?**  
Send artwork references, product dimensions, approximate quantities, and destination markets via https://www.tendlyn.com/contact/ — typical reply within one business day with timing and next steps.

Homepage FAQ: https://www.tendlyn.com/#faq
